summary: Each ~852 KB software D3D9 draw context reserved a fresh address range because $d3d_software_compact's $heap_shrink split the context's whole large arena, so the freed context missed $heap_large_free. With $heap_shrink leaving whole large-arena blocks intact, render-worker CPU per draw control -> fix: rep 1 900-1200 s 14.67 -> 9.93 ms, 1200-1500 s 10.68 -> 7.37 ms (85.9 -> 119.4 draws/s, 0.156 -> 0.203 fps); rep 2 (both profiled) 900-1200 s 9.89 -> 6.31 ms, 1200-1500 s 11.44 -> 8.34 ms; land load 600-900 s unchanged within noise. 0 failed draws in all runs. Worker profile 1190-1490 s inclusive control -> fix: $virtual_range_edge_locked 13.5% -> not sampled, $heap_large_alloc 22.8% -> 1.7%, $d3d_software_create_mode 23.5% -> 3.3%, $heap_arena_find 17.6% -> 5.7%, $d3d_software_step 39.2% -> 59.2%. Same frame: frozen-clock runs of both builds to 4000 batches (1231 software D3D requests each) wrote byte-identical PNGs (md5 5f689f648aa8798aebb71e2dad6def29, Lionhead logo intro); rep 1 600 s and 900 s captures byte-identical between arms. New test/test-d3d-software-ctx-arena-reuse.js fails on control (block split 872448 -> 120008) and passes on the fix; heap/d3d/render-worker/virtual unit suites (219 tests) are identical between arms apart from that test.
